prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent PNG cutout for a mobile focus app's completion animation, replacing a crude SVG cat.
Create ONE beautifully crafted, charming silver-gray tabby CAT UPPER BODY, viewed from ABOVE AND BEHIND. The cat is entering from the TOP edge of a phone screen and reaching DOWNWARD into the screen to stamp a paw print. Its back and BACK OF THE HEAD are all we see. Head faces the BOTTOM of the image, with rounded shoulders above the head. Show only upper back, nape, two ears from behind, and two FRONT LEGS. The upper back continues out of the TOP image edge, deliberately cropped there. No rump, no hind legs, no tail, no face, NO EYES, no nose, no mouth, no visible belly.
Pose: the viewer's RIGHT front leg reaches farther DOWN, with its rounded fluffy paw the lowest part of the whole silhouette; the LEFT front leg is held slightly higher, relaxed. The right paw is preparing to press the surface beneath it. Clear readable organic silhouette; both front legs connect naturally to the shoulders.
Art direction: premium animated-film character asset, softly sculpted 3D form with gorgeous short velvety fur, natural subtle silver-gray tabby stripes, little wispy edge hairs, plump paws, softly rounded ear backs. Affectionate and cozy, anatomically recognizable cat rather than a sausage-shaped body. Refined polished rendering, natural soft shadows ON the cat, gentle neutral studio light from upper left, restrained grayscale palette to look excellent on a charcoal #272727 app. No outline, no flat vector style, no crude primitive shapes, no overly shiny plastic.
Composition: vertical portrait, cat silhouette large and centered, upper back exits at top edge; retain ample transparent space around the left/right contours and beneath the lowest right paw. Orthographic near-overhead camera so dorsal body, nape, and back of head are visible. No scene, no floor, no cast shadow outside cat, no UI, no text, no paw-print graphic. Genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with clean alpha. This is a single reusable character cutout, not an animation sheet, not a screenshot.
